notify_failed.message: Unable to send the notification to Kodi. Is Kodi online?

deprecated_yaml_notify_entity.description:
The `{action}` action, set up with the Kodi notify platform in your `configuration.yaml` file, is no longer supported and will be removed in a future release.

A replacement notify entity, `{entity_id}`, was created for your Kodi device {title}. Update your automations and scripts to use the `notify.send_message` or `kodi.send_message` action with this entity.

Once the new notify entity and actions are in use, remove the Kodi notify configuration (`platform: kodi`) from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant.
deprecated_yaml_notify_entity.title: The Kodi notify action {action} is deprecated

deprecated_yaml_notify_entry_disabled.description:
The `{action}` action, set up with the Kodi notify platform in your `configuration.yaml` file, is no longer supported and will be removed in a future release.

Your Kodi device {title} matches this configuration, but it is disabled, so its replacement notify entity is not set up. Enable the Kodi device to get its notify entity, which you can use with the `notify.send_message` or `kodi.send_message` action.

Once your automations and scripts use the new notify entity, remove the Kodi notify configuration (`platform: kodi`) from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant.
deprecated_yaml_notify_entry_disabled.title: [%key:component::kodi::issues::deprecated_yaml_notify_entity::title%]

deprecated_yaml_notify_no_entry.description:
The `{action}` action, set up with the Kodi notify platform in your `configuration.yaml` file, is no longer supported and will be removed in a future release.

No Kodi device in Home Assistant matches the host, port, and credentials of this configuration, so no replacement notify entity was created. Follow the [Kodi instructions]({url}) to add your Kodi device. It comes with a notify entity that you can use with the `notify.send_message` or `kodi.send_message` action.

Once your automations and scripts use the new notify entity, remove the Kodi notify configuration (`platform: kodi`) from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant.
deprecated_yaml_notify_no_entry.title: [%key:component::kodi::issues::deprecated_yaml_notify_entity::title%]
